title: igs-iec104-runtime events
description: An event of the client role, as the control API reports it (GET /v1/events). Versioned with runtime-api.yaml: both carry the same contract version.

Event.description: One recorded event: its kind selects the fields that follow it.

seq.description: Sequence number, from 1, with no gap while the events are kept.

observed_at_ms.description: The time the event was recorded: milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

generation.description: The connection generation the event was recorded in: the number of connections so far.

endpoint.description: The station of a redundancy group the event came from, in the order the stations were given. Absent for a client of one station, and for an event of the group itself.

Point.description: A point value that an ASDU of the station carried, decoded. It is recorded right after the ASDU that carried it, one event per point.

address.description: The information object address of the point.

type_id.description: The type identification of the ASDU that carried the value.

value.description: The value in the form of its kind: a boolean (single), off, on, intermediate or indeterminate (double), a number (normalized, scaled, float, or the normalized values without quality), an integer (counter or bitstring), an object with value and transient (step), or an object with status and change (packed).

cause.description: The cause of transmission of the ASDU, without the P/N and test bits.

common_address.description: The common address of the ASDU.

time.description: The time tag, for a time-tagged type. The CP56Time2a year is read as 2000 plus it.
